lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A rectilinear grid of approximately 5 horizontal rows of roughly circular high-luminance pixel clusters, distributed with uniform spatial frequency along the mid-lateral flank posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the horizontal rows of blobs to form a matrix of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity pixels on the superior edge and shadowed pixels on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct V-shaped notch is visible on the posterior margin of the first dorsal fin silhouette.
other_distinctive_markers: A high-density pattern of small, disordered speckles is visible on the cranial region, transitioning into the structured grid of larger blobs on the posterior flank.
